description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Olaf''' strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage.
description.text: Active: Olaf strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing  true damage.

description2.raw: If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] himself equal to the [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] health cost.
description2.text: If Reckless Swing kills the target, Olaf heals himself equal to the  health cost.

description3.raw: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.
description3.text: Basic attacks reduce Reckless Swing's  cooldown by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

leveling.raw:
'''True Damage:'''
70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 (+ 50% AD)

notes.raw: * The health cost is equal to 40% of ''Reckless Swing's'' true damage value. * ''Reckless Swing'' can be cast even if '''Olaf''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost. ** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Reckless Swing'' will not reduce '''Olaf's''' health below 1. * ''Reckless Swing's'' health refund is considered a [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] therefore it is affected by healing modifiers. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable). ** '''Olaf''' will also not receive the benefits from killing an enemy if this canceling takes place very shortly before the attack hits the invalidated target, but ''Reckless Swing's'' effect will be consumed.(bug)
notes.text:
The health cost is equal to 40% of Reckless Swing's true damage value.
Reckless Swing can be cast even if Olaf doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.
* As with all abilities with health costs, Reckless Swing will not reduce Olaf's health below 1.
Reckless Swing's health refund is considered a heal therefore it is affected by healing modifiers.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
* Olaf will also not receive the benefits from killing an enemy if this canceling takes place very shortly before the attack hits the invalidated target, but Reckless Swing's effect will be consumed.(bug)
